verdict.rationale: ClickUp documents a public API, webhooks, OAuth, and an MCP server for AI integration, showing broad but not exhaustive API surface area; there's no explicit documentation or independent confirmation that the API achieves full feature parity with the 100+ product UI (Docs, Whiteboards, Chat, Sprints, Automations, Brain² agents, etc.). Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation covering all UI modules (Whiteboards, Chat, Docs, Brain² agent config), and independent/hands-on verification that API coverage matches UI capability.
